mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders_detail ( od_no, od_name, od_quantity, od_sub_date, od_price, o_no, p_no ) VALUES ( orders_detail_seq.NEXTVAL, #{od_name}, #{od_quantity}, #{od_sub_date}, #{od_price}, #{o_no}, #{p_no} )
mapper.select: SELECT o.o_no, o.o_date, o.o_status, o.m_no, od.od_name, od.od_price, od.p_no, p.p_image FROM orders o JOIN orders_detail od ON o.o_no = od.o_no JOIN product p ON od.p_no = p.p_no WHERE o.m_no = #{m_no} ORDER BY o.o_no DESC

SELECT od.od_no, od.od_name, od.od_quantity, od.od_sub_date, od.od_price, od.o_no, od.p_no, p.p_image AS p_image FROM orders_detail od JOIN orders o ON od.o_no = o.o_no JOIN product p ON od.p_no = p.p_no WHERE o.m_no = #{m_no} AND od.o_no = #{o_no} ORDER BY od.od_no
SELECT o.o_no, o.o_date, o.o_status, o.m_no, od.od_name, od.od_quantity, od.od_price FROM orders o JOIN orders_detail od ON o.o_no = od.o_no ORDER BY o.o_no DESC
